title: Action
description: One capability an agent may PROPOSE. Declared in a pack manifest. The runtime validates, gates, executes, verifies and audits it; the model never executes it directly.

id.description: Action id, unique within the pack.

description.description: What the action does and when to use it; shown to the planner.

autonomy.description: Current autonomy level. Always explicit; promotion happens by event, not by editing defaults.

params.description: JSON Schema of the parameters. Restricted to a closed object of typed scalar properties.

preconditions.description: CEL expressions over fresh world state and params; all must hold for the gate to allow.

effects.description: CEL expressions that must hold after execution; checked by the verifier.

envelope.description: Operating envelope (ADR-0009). 'params' bounds numeric params and is enforced by the gate and again by the connector; 'limits' are named limits the connector enforces, such as a ramp rate.

params.description: Param name to inclusive bounds, e.g. {'temp': {'max': 240}}. Each param must be declared and numeric (rule ENVELOPE_PARAM_MISMATCH).

limits.description: Named numeric limits, e.g. {'temp_ramp_degc_per_minute': 10}. Available to CEL as envelope.limits.

verify_within_s.description: Seconds within which the effects must be observed.

compensation.description: Action that undoes this one if verification fails. Params are CEL over 'params' and 'prev' (state before execution).

action.description: Action id in the same pack.

sandbox.description: Id of a sandbox declared in the manifest, run before execution.

approvers.description: Number of distinct humans who must approve when approval is required.

rate_limit.description: At most 'max' executions per 'per_s' seconds, per session.

idempotent.description: True if executing twice with the same params has the same effect as once.

allOf.description: high and critical actions never run without a human: autonomy is capped at L2.
Acting without per-execution approval (L3/L4) requires verification and a way back.

bound.description: Inclusive bounds on one param; at least one of min and max.

param.description: One typed parameter. Only these keywords are allowed, so a typo fails validation instead of being ignored.
